newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet should be sold on time as block - MD.
newsitem.headline: Stet should be sold on time as block - MD.

text.p: Italian state telecoms group Stet's Managing Director Ernesto Pascale said he hoped Stet would be sold off according to the government's privatisation timetable and said he was against the holding being sold off in pieces.
The government has said Stet should be sold by the end of March 1997 but this could be delayed because a necessary watchdog body for the telecoms sector has not yet been created.
"I hope the government's calendar can be respected," Pascale told reporters while attending a business meeting.

He said that if the idea of selling off Stet in bits prevailed then "we would have a string of smaller companies in a world which is otherwise getting bigger...one needs to be strong to be able to operate and compete in the global market."
